decisions.label: Tree cap: keep above it
decisions.note: How much of each tree's height over the cap it keeps (Ed, 2026-10-26: "Can we have the tree height cap as a menu slider?"): 0.35 as built (a 45 m tree shows 29 m), 1 no cap at all (the art's own heights: home's trees average 23.7 m, not 19.3). The oak's crown tops out at 32.3 m: with the cap from 20 m, anything over 0.35 has home trees taller than it (0.4: 675 of its 17,069; 0.6: 2,108; 1: 4,107). The jungle's tallest grow most (49 m to about 67 m at 0.6). Live: no rebake, drawn again at once.

decisions.label: Tree cap: from (m)
decisions.note: The height (metres) over which a tree is squeezed: 20 as built, so her 24 m treetop flight stays mostly over the canopy. Raising it lets more trees stand at their full height, and they top the oak's 32.3 m crown sooner (25 m at keep 0.35: 986 of home's trees). Live: no rebake, drawn again at once.
